0.content: For thirty years, spatial quakes have devastated the world. Shido Itsuka leaves a shelter during one alarm to search for Kotori and finds a lone armored girl standing in the crater. He learns that the Anti-Spirit Team attacks Spirits on sight and that Origami is one of its soldiers. He is then brought aboard Ratatoskr's airship, where Kotori reveals a different plan: if Shido can make a Spirit fall in love with him and kiss her, he can seal her power.

1.content: Shido meets the girl again inside the ruined school. While AST opens fire, he speaks to her instead of running. When he asks her name, she admits she has none, so he gives her the name Tohka from the date they met. Tohka is shaken by receiving something other than fear or violence, and Shido becomes determined to save her rather than let either AST or Ratatoskr treat her like a disaster.

2.content: Ratatoskr stages a date across the city while the crew coaches Shido through every choice. Tohka experiences ordinary pleasures for the first time, especially food, crowds, games, and the simple joy of being treated kindly. She begins to trust Shido and to love the world he is showing her. At the same time, Origami shadows them and prepares to kill Tohka the moment she gets a clear shot.

3.content: At the end of the date, Origami fires on Tohka and Shido throws himself in front of the blast. Believing her only friend has been killed, Tohka loses control and prepares to destroy everything around her. Shido revives through the mysterious healing power sleeping inside him and reaches her before she can go too far. Tohka kisses him, her Astral Dress vanishes, and her power is sealed. She asks him to take her on another date.

4.content: Shido meets a timid girl in a raincoat at a shrine and later learns she is the Spirit Yoshino, known for bringing cold rain wherever she appears. Tohka has started attending school and living close to Shido, but she still does not understand her growing attachment to him. When Shido tries to reach Yoshino during another appearance, Tohka follows him instead of staying behind.

5.content: Shido stumbles and accidentally kisses Yoshino in front of Tohka. Shocked by the jealousy she cannot yet name, Tohka grabs Yoshino's puppet Yoshinon during the confusion. Losing Yoshinon sends Yoshino into a panic because the puppet acts as her voice, courage, and emotional anchor. Her power surges out of control, the area freezes, and she flees inside a wall of ice.

6.content: Reine helps Tohka understand that what she is feeling is jealousy, and Tohka is horrified that her own confusion hurt Yoshino. Shido learns from Kotori that Yoshinon is more than a toy to Yoshino and tracks the puppet to Origami's apartment. He retrieves it after a tense visit with Origami, who makes clear that she still sees Spirits as enemies. Tohka decides to help repair the damage she caused.

7.content: Tohka draws AST away so Shido can reach Yoshino's frozen refuge. He returns Yoshinon, promises to become someone Yoshino can rely on, and calms the fear that made her hide from the world. Once Yoshino accepts him, Shido seals her power with a kiss. Afterward, Ratatoskr prepares a place for the sealed Spirits to live safely near him.

8.content: Mana Takamiya arrives in Japan as a powerful wizard tied to DEM and shocks Shido by claiming to be his biological sister. Soon after, Kurumi Tokisaki transfers into his class, smiling sweetly while openly admitting she is a Spirit. Ratatoskr identifies her as Nightmare, the Spirit blamed for enormous loss of life. Unlike the girls Shido has saved so far, Kurumi steps into his life with her own agenda and no interest in being harmless.

9.content: Shido tries to understand Kurumi, but she quickly shows how dangerous she is. She manipulates time and shadows with Zafkiel, survives seemingly impossible attacks, and casually kills boys who were abusing a stray cat. Ratatoskr warns Shido that Kurumi is after the power he has sealed from other Spirits. Even after seeing the blood she leaves behind, he still wants to believe she can be saved.

10.content: Shido arranges a date with Kurumi, only for Tohka and Origami to force themselves into the same day. Ratatoskr turns the outing into a frantic juggling act, moving him from one girl to another while he tries to keep Tohka happy, keep Origami from turning the date into a hunt, and learn what Kurumi really wants. During the gaps, Kurumi shows flashes of genuine warmth that make her even harder for him to dismiss as a monster.

11.content: Kurumi traps Raizen High inside her shadow field and reveals the scale of her power. Her shadow hands are versions of herself from different points in time, and she intends to gather enough energy to use her Twelfth Bullet to go back and kill the first Spirit. Mana battles Kurumi's copies while Tohka and Origami try to protect Shido, but Kurumi corners him and prepares to take everything sealed inside him.

12.content: One of Kurumi's own copies, having fallen for Shido, turns on the original and buys him a moment. Flames tear across the sky and Kotori descends in Spirit form as Ifrit, wielding Camael and forcing Kurumi to retreat. The battle leaves Kurumi unsealed, Kotori exposed, and Shido shaken by how far the conflict has escalated. Origami also realizes that the flame Spirit she has hunted for years may be much closer to him than she ever imagined.

13.content: Kotori's power grows unstable after revealing herself, and Ratatoskr explains that five years earlier Phantom turned her into a Spirit and tied her power to Shido. Shido and Kotori both lost their memories of that day, but the seal between them is beginning to fail. If Shido cannot seal her again, Kotori may be consumed by the destructive side of Ifrit. Reine confirms that the only path forward is the same one he has used before.

14.content: Shido is told to make his own sister fall in love with him, and the plan goes badly from the start. Kotori's black-ribbon commander side sees through Ratatoskr's usual dating tricks and shoots them down one after another. The more carefully Shido follows the script in his ear, the more artificial he sounds. It becomes clear that Kotori will never respond to a performance.

15.content: Shido throws away the script and starts speaking to Kotori as her brother. He takes her to places that mattered to them as children, including the pool and amusement park, and Kotori slowly drops her guard. Their shared memories reach her more deeply than Ratatoskr's advice ever could. For the first time since her instability began, Kotori looks less like Ratatoskr's commander and more like the girl who just wants her brother beside her.

16.content: Origami attacks when she identifies Kotori as the flame Spirit she blames for her parents' deaths. Kotori and Origami clash violently until Kotori's rage and Spirit instincts begin to take over. Shido throws himself between them and kisses Kotori, sealing her power before she kills Origami. The seal restores the memories both siblings lost five years earlier and confirms Phantom's role in changing their lives.

17.content: During a school trip to Arubi Island, a violent storm gathers overhead and two Spirits crash into Shido's life in the middle of their duel. They are Kaguya and Yuzuru, the Yamai twins, known together as Berserk. Instead of trying to kill Shido, they announce that their hundredth contest will be a battle to win his heart. Their cheerful absurdity hides the fact that the loser of their rivalry is expected to disappear.

18.content: Kaguya and Yuzuru explain that they were once a single Spirit and have spent years competing to decide which of them should remain. As Shido spends time with both sisters, he discovers that each secretly wants the other to survive and is planning to lose on purpose. Their rivalry is less about pride than a desperate attempt to give the other girl a future. Shido refuses to accept a choice that ends with one of them erased.

19.content: DEM arranged the trip and sends Ellen Mira Mathers to watch Tohka from the shadows. When the twins' conflict reaches its breaking point, Ellen launches Bandersnatch units and moves to seize Tohka. Shido draws on the power he sealed from Tohka and summons Sandalphon, proving that the Spirits' power can live through him after sealing. The island becomes a battlefield around the twins' final duel.

20.content: Shido interrupts the Yamai sisters before either can sacrifice herself. He offers them a third path: let him seal both of them so neither has to vanish. Kaguya and Yuzuru accept, combine their power one last time to destroy the enemy warship attacking them, and then allow Shido to seal them. Their rivalry survives, but now it looks more like playful bickering than a death sentence.

21.content: At the Tenou Festival, a new Spirit appears through song instead of open destruction. She is Miku Izayoi, a famous idol whose voice can dominate people's wills, and she despises men so completely that Ratatoskr has Shido approach her disguised as a girl named Shiori. Miku quickly takes interest in Shiori, but her warmth turns cold the moment she suspects deception. She challenges Shiori to defeat her at the festival and demands total submission if she loses.

22.content: Miku uses her charm, status, and Angel to tilt everything in her favor while Shido scrambles to hold Raizen's performance together. Even girls who should have been his allies end up swayed by Miku's voice. AST and DEM both move around the edges of the festival, using the noise and confusion as cover. Shido realizes that beating Miku will require more than a successful show, because her hatred of men is rooted far deeper than simple pride.

23.content: Raizen wins the overall contest, but the result only enrages Miku. She brainwashes nearly everyone nearby, discovers that Shiori is really Shido, and turns the city against him. While Shido escapes with Kurumi's unexpected help, DEM abducts Tohka and confines her in a facility where Westcott tries to break her spirit. Shido is left with a collapsing city behind him and Tohka in enemy hands.

24.content: As Shido closes in on Tohka, Miku finally reveals why she began hating men. A producer once tried to exploit her, malicious rumors destroyed her career, and the shock stole her singing voice until Phantom gave her Spirit power. Shido promises that he is not approaching her for selfish reasons and keeps pushing forward to rescue Tohka. Before he can finish reaching either girl, Ellen strikes him down in front of Tohka.

25.content: Seeing Shido fall sends Tohka into inversion. A dark new self takes over, armed with a black blade and no memory of the warmth Shido showed her. The other Spirits hold the line long enough for Shido to reach her again and call her back from the darkness. He seals Tohka once more, and afterward Miku willingly accepts a kiss from him as well. Her hatred does not vanish overnight, but she chooses to stand with the others instead of against them.

26.content: Shido meets Natsumi, a witchlike Spirit who first appears as a beautiful older woman and seems almost friendly. After AST interrupts the encounter, Natsumi decides that Shido has seen something she never wanted anyone to see, so she tells him his life as he knows it is over, and retreats. She disguises herself as him and wreaks havoc on his reputation at school, turning classmates and teachers against him. By the time Tohka and Origami expose the fake, Natsumi has already prepared a crueler game.

27.content: Natsumi sends Shido a set of photos and declares that she is hiding among the people closest to him. If he cannot find her, she will make them disappear one by one. Shido goes on hurried dates with his friends, searching for small tells while more people vanish. He finally realizes that Natsumi is not disguised as a person at all, but as Yoshinon.
27.comment: The Witch Hides in Plain Sight

28.content: Once exposed, Natsumi loses control and her real form is revealed: a small, frail girl consumed by shame over her appearance. She lashes out by turning the other Spirits into children and leaving Shido to deal with the chaos. DEM chooses that moment to attack, hoping to seize her while she is vulnerable. The rescue leaves Natsumi exhausted and in Ratatoskr's custody, but not at peace.

29.content: Shido and the others try to help Natsumi by treating her gently, taking her shopping, and showing her that she is not disgusting to them. She cannot believe it and disguises herself as Kotori to spy on what everyone really thinks. At the same time, DEM executives try to kill Westcott by dropping a satellite on the city, putting everyone in danger. Natsumi runs away just as the crisis peaks, convinced she does not belong with anyone.

30.content: Shido searches the evacuating city for Natsumi instead of abandoning her to save himself. When a second strike threatens to finish the disaster, Natsumi returns and helps destroy it alongside the other Spirits. She finally accepts that the group wants her with them for who she is, not for how she looks. With that fear broken, she allows Shido to seal her power. The victory is immediately overshadowed when Origami reappears in a DEM combat suit.

31.content: Origami leaves school and throws in her lot with DEM, deciding that more power and more information are worth any price. She captures Shido and tells him that even sealed Spirits are still targets if they stand between her and revenge. While Ratatoskr fights Ellen in the sky, Origami marches toward the other Spirits below. Her obsession has hardened into something even Shido struggles to reach.

32.content: Origami battles the girls with ruthless force until Tohka regains enough power to wound her badly. On the edge of death and unable to let go of revenge, Origami accepts Phantom's offer and becomes a Spirit herself. Armed with Metatron, she declares that she will kill every Spirit and then herself if that is what it takes to end the cycle. Shido stops her only long enough for her to retreat and look for a way to rewrite the past.

33.content: Origami asks Kurumi to send her five years back so she can save her parents. In the past, she attacks Phantom with everything she has and only afterward realizes the blast that killed her parents came from her own hand. The Spirit she hated for years was her future self. When she returns to the present, the shock shatters her and drags her into inversion.

34.content: Inverse Origami descends on Tengu City as a blank, merciless force of destruction. Shido and the other Spirits fight her, but nothing they say can reach her in that state. Kurumi judges that the present Origami cannot be saved anymore and sends Shido into the past instead. He is given a narrow chance to change the one moment that destroyed her life.

35.content: In the past, Shido watches future Origami attack Phantom on the day Kotori first received her power. He realizes he cannot stop the battle entirely, so he changes the result by pushing Origami's parents out of the blast and taking the hit himself. Before consciousness leaves him, he tells the young Origami to let him carry the grief she cannot bear. When he wakes in the present, the world around him has changed.

36.content: The new timeline contains an Origami with a softer personality and different memories. Her parents still died, but in this version of events they were lost in a car accident, and Origami served in AST before later stepping away from it. Kurumi alone remembers the original history besides Shido, and the memories of both versions of Origami begin slipping into one another. Shido takes her on a date, accepts the burden of both selves, and reaches her when the darker side resurfaces. He seals her power with a kiss and gives her a future that is no longer driven by revenge alone.

37.content: With so many sealed powers circulating through him, Shido's body begins to overheat and twist under the strain. His strength spikes, his judgment collapses, and the Spirit power inside him starts spilling into the world around him. Reine warns that if the circulation is not stabilized before midnight, Shido himself could become the center of a catastrophic disaster. The girls are told that the only solution is to reverse the flow by kissing him.

38.content: Shido's distorted state turns the crisis into a bizarre contest as the Spirits try to make him fall for them and bring his heart back under control. He lashes out, borrows their powers recklessly, and drags the city toward another spatial quake. Kurumi appears to help at the last moment, but it is Tohka who reaches him most clearly. Her feelings break through the chaos, she kisses him, and the unstable power flow settles back into place.

39.content: Kurumi breaks into a DEM facility and finds a captive Spirit named Nia Honjou. Not long afterward, Shido runs into Nia starving on the street and learns that she is both a Spirit and a manga artist. Nia already knows who he is because Raziel lets her see almost anything she wants to know. She agrees to spend time with him, but only as a joke, because she insists she can only love fictional characters.

40.content: Since ordinary dating fails, Ratatoskr answers Nia on her own ground by entering a manga festival. The Spirits pour themselves into a book about the times Shido saved them, while Shido and Kotori look into the friendship Nia abandoned because Raziel kept tempting her to invade other people's secrets. At the festival, Nia admits that endless knowledge has made real trust feel impossible. Shido answers by telling her he will trust her anyway.

41.content: The contest ends in a draw, but Nia reads the manga and is moved by it. Westcott then forces her trauma back to the surface and drives her into inversion, turning Raziel into Beelzebub. DEM steals the crystal at the heart of that transformation and Westcott takes its power for himself. A fragment of Nia's original crystal remains, allowing Shido to seal her weakened power. As she recovers, Nia reveals that most Spirits began as ordinary human beings.

42.content: An asteroid nearly slams into Shido's school, and Ratatoskr traces the disturbance to a Spirit living in space. Using a projection device, Shido speaks to Mukuro Hoshimiya and learns that her Angel can lock and unlock not just objects but memories, emotions, and abilities. Mukuro has already used it on herself, sealing away her own heart. She refuses to come to Earth and warns that if anyone forces the issue, she can stop the planet's rotation.

43.content: Ratatoskr launches the Fraxinus Excelsior to reach Mukuro before DEM does. Just before departure, Woodman admits that he once founded DEM beside Westcott, Ellen, and Karen before turning against that mission and building Ratatoskr instead. Westcott answers by trapping Shido and the Spirits inside a twisted storybook world made from fairy tales and manga. They escape only with help from the heroic version of Shido created in their own comic.

44.content: Fraxinus catches up to Mukuro in space while DEM attacks from all sides. Using Haniel to copy Michael, Shido unlocks the emotions Mukuro sealed away and shields her during the chaos that follows. Once her heart opens, her cold distance disappears almost at once. Mukuro clings to Shido with fierce gratitude and agrees to stay near him.

45.content: Mukuro's new affection quickly turns possessive. When Shido insists that he must keep saving everyone, she answers by locking away the world's memories of him so no one else can claim him. Almost everyone forgets that he exists, but the new timeline's Origami still remembers him, and so does Tohka's inverted self. Shido is left in a city that feels empty of every bond he fought to build.

46.content: Origami tries to broker peace with a strange double date, but the tension between Mukuro and Inverse Tohka erupts into battle. A visit to the tower tied to Mukuro's foster-family memories breaks open the pain she locked away long ago, including the moment she erased her foster sister Asahi from everyone's memory and was rejected for it. Shido comforts her and promises to be family without taking anyone else's place. Mukuro accepts the seal, the world's memories return, and regular Tohka comes back.

47.content: Kurumi returns with a proposal: if Shido can make her fall in love first, he may seal her power, but if she wins, she will take his life and the power within him. He accepts because he still wants to save her. DEM immediately begins pressing harder, fielding Nibelcolle copies and new attacks to prevent any alliance between them. Kurumi's reappearance turns every calm day into a countdown.

48.content: As Valentine's Day approaches, the household becomes crowded with chocolate-making and half-serious competition for Shido's attention. Kurumi slips into these ordinary moments almost like one of the girls while still keeping everyone on edge. She spends quiet time with Shido at school and during their dates, letting him see a softer side she rarely shows. The calm only makes the danger around her feel sharper.

49.content: Kurumi finally shares her memories with Shido. Before becoming a Spirit, she met Mio Takamiya and was chosen because she could perceive what others could not. Mio gave her a Sephira crystal and sent her to hunt monsters across the city, only for Kurumi to learn too late that those monsters were humans warped by unstable crystals. One of them was her friend Sawa, and that discovery turned Kurumi's life into a long pursuit of Mio.

50.content: When Nibelcolle attacks again, one of Kurumi's alternate selves reveals how much she has already done for Shido. Kurumi has repeated the same period more than two hundred times, rewinding it whenever DEM kills him. She admits that somewhere along the way she fell in love with the person she kept trying to protect. Soon after, Kurumi and her copies corner Phantom and tear away the mask, exposing Reine as the figure who has been creating Spirits.

51.content: Kurumi's copies go to war with DEM while Ratatoskr prepares for a direct clash. On the battlefield, AST finally sees DEM treat them as expendable and breaks away to side with Ratatoskr. Shido also confronts the Nibelcolle and calms them not through force, but by treating them like frightened people rather than disposable weapons. For a moment, it looks as if the many sides around him may finally be turning toward the same enemy.

52.content: Shido reunites with Kurumi in the middle of the battle and asks her not to erase the life they all built together, even if that life is painful. Kurumi still wants the power inside him, but she hesitates long enough for disaster to strike. Mio Takamiya, the Spirit of Origin, emerges from Kurumi's body and tears through her. Kurumi falls, and the war changes from a struggle against DEM into a fight against the source of the entire tragedy.

53.content: Mio's past is finally shown in full. Thirty years earlier, she wandered into the world with no memory and was found by a young man named Shinji Takamiya, who gave her a name, a home, and the first kindness she had ever known. Shinji, Mana, and Mio began to live like family, and love grew between the two of them. Westcott shattered that brief peace by hunting Mio and killing Shinji in front of her.

54.content: Shinji's death turned Mio's love into a centuries-long obsession. She absorbed his body, resolved to bring him back, and spread her power across many girls so a reborn Shinji could one day gather it through them as Shido. In the present, she restores Shido's memories of his former life and reveals that Reine was another piece of herself placed at his side to watch that plan unfold. Shido cannot accept what she has done in the name of love.

55.content: Mio unfolds her Territory and begins taking back the power she once distributed. Kaguya falls first, then Yuzuru, Yoshino, Mukuro, Origami, Nia, Kotori, Miku, and Natsumi as the battlefield collapses around Shido. Even Westcott is cast down once he has served his role. Tohka is the last to keep fighting beside Shido, but Mio erases her too and leaves him alone inside a world built from her will.

56.content: Shido is almost crushed by grief and ready to let Mio overwrite him, but Tohka returns for a brief, impossible final stand from within Mio's inner world. Her courage gives him just enough strength to keep fighting until Kurumi's last surviving self reaches him. That final Kurumi reveals the true purpose of everything her original had done and leads him to the Sixth Bullet he already carries. Shido sends his consciousness back to the night before the war.

57.content: With the future's horror in mind, Shido chooses a completely different path. Instead of waiting for the war to begin, he asks Reine out and spends the day giving Mio's quieter self the happiness she never managed to keep. He tells Kotori the truth, wins over the other Spirits, and quietly sets pieces into place around them. Even when the planned seal fails at first, the date reaches Mio in a way battle never could.

58.content: Kurumi sacrifices everything left to her so Mio cannot simply reclaim her own power and reset the board again. Shido, now carrying the strength of every Spirit, reaches Mio inside a closed world of memories and learns that a part of her always wanted him to become strong enough to stop her. Westcott forces a last catastrophe by turning himself into a new Origin, but the Spirits fight beside Shido and Mio to bring him down. Mio says goodbye, entrusts the future to Shido, vanishes with Shinji, and the others return to their ordinary lives. Some time later, Shido and Tohka go out together again.
